# Tucano Labs

> Tucano Labs is a New Zealand tech startup building Tucano Nest, an AI-powered,
> cloud-based all-in-one business platform that unifies ERP, CRM and BI in a
> single system, with Kea, an LLM-based AI assistant that works like a member
> of your team. Currently in beta with early-access customers.

## Products

- [Tucano Nest](https://tucanolabs.net/#product): AI-powered one-stop-shop
  business platform. Modules: ERP (invoicing, purchasing, inventory, cash flow),
  CRM (pipeline, contacts, quotes, follow-ups), BI (live dashboards,
  natural-language reporting, forecasting). Cloud-native SaaS built on Google
  Cloud. Development stage: beta, live with early-access customers.
- [Kea AI Assistant](https://tucanolabs.net/#kea): LLM-based AI assistant built
  into Tucano Nest. Answers plain-English questions over business data, drafts
  invoices, emails and reports, automates routine workflows with human
  approval.

## Services

- [Solutions & Services](https://tucanolabs.net/#services): custom AI
  automation, integrations and data migration/onboarding delivered on top of
  the Tucano Nest platform.

## Company

- [About Us](https://tucanolabs.net/#about): founded by Bruno Santos
  (Co-Founder & CTO, 17+ years engineering high-scale platforms) and Danilo
  Albertini (Co-Founder & CEO, 16+ years in product, data science and BI).
  Based in Auckland, New Zealand. Available worldwide.
